title: Hex Drift
tagline: A six-sided tunnel at terminal velocity.
description: You are falling down a hexagonal shaft that keeps closing in. Roll the tunnel so the open face lines up before you reach it — and it keeps getting faster. WebGL, sixty frames a second, one very unforgiving corridor.
author: HexCave
controls: Arrow keys or A / D to roll
howToPlay: You are falling down a six-sided tunnel. Roll it left or right with the arrow keys or A and D — on touch, tap the left or right half of the screen.
Each roll turns the tunnel by one face, bringing a different panel to the bottom where your craft sits.
Barriers block some faces of each ring. Line the open face up with your craft before you reach it.
The first few rings are wide open. After that the gaps narrow and the whole thing accelerates.
Touching a barrier ends the run. Press space to start again, or to pause mid-fall.
goal: Get as far down the shaft as you can. Distance is the score, and your best is kept.
